title: Per-customer volume report
body:
Account managers want to see how much each customer ships.

Add `volume_report()` to `parcelo/reports.py`. It returns a dict keyed by customer id, where each value is `{"shipments": <count>, "tier": <label>}`. The count is the number of shipments the customer has, and every customer is included, even ones with no shipments. The tier label uses the same thresholds as `volume_tier` in `parcelo/legacy/billing.py`.
